description: No clean concept; a weak, left-right asymmetric mixture. Fires most often when I must block the opponent in column 1 (strongest when they just dropped a stone at the bottom of column 1 under their own row/diagonal threat at (1,1)), when they have three stacked in column 6, or early when my bottom stone in column 2 is capped by theirs with column 3 empty. Mirror-image patterns do not fire.
effect: None measurable: forcing it high or off changes move probabilities by under 0.05 in most positions (occasionally 0.1-0.16 swaps between two candidate columns, no consistent direction).
notes: Best dev F1 0.244 (P 0.21, R 0.29, AUROC 0.63), simulation share 0.02. Any must-block: F1 0.13. Minimal pairs show strong column-specific effects (col-2 cap, (1,1) block, right-side row-0 threat) with mirrors near zero; near-threshold positions show <=10-point single-cell differences vs non-firing. Possibly a random direction or a polysemantic mix. Synthesis B,4,0,1 reaches 5.23 > dev max 4.66.
